sentences.text: Juvenile nephropathic cystinosis and nephropathic infantile cystinosis are both linked to the gene CTNS in curated databases [e_997a90c6f1e1] [e_6fbefb0b0214].
Constellate computed that their listed symptoms overlap, with a score of 0.477, which is inferred and not a diagnosis [e_224cdda7b048].
For the juvenile form, a raised level of cystine inside cells is an observed feature [e_87bf50c02933].
Protein in the urine is also an observed feature of the juvenile form [e_c5980ec6fcf5].
Both observations rest on small counts, 2 of 2 in the records [e_87bf50c02933] [e_c5980ec6fcf5].
For the infantile form, one patient registry and natural history study is listed as recruiting [e_e939e060e080].
A registry collects information and is not a treatment trial [e_e939e060e080].
These edges list no symptoms for the infantile form and no treatment study [e_6fbefb0b0214].
